name: leaf-calendar
title: Leaf Calendar
description: See your agenda, join meetings, create and move events, and share booking times through Leaf Calendar.
author: artistro08

commands.name: agenda
commands.title: My Agenda
commands.subtitle: Leaf Calendar
commands.description: See your upcoming events, join meetings, and move events.

commands.name: create-event
commands.title: Create Event
commands.subtitle: Leaf Calendar
commands.description: Add an event to one of your calendars.

commands.name: join-next-meeting
commands.title: Join Next Meeting
commands.subtitle: Leaf Calendar
commands.description: Join the meeting Leaf Calendar's join shortcut would pick.

commands.name: find-time-to-meet
commands.title: Find a Time to Meet
commands.subtitle: Leaf Calendar
commands.description: Pick free times to offer someone, copy them as a message, and keep them on your calendar.

preferences.name: slotMinutes
preferences.title: Time Slots
preferences.description: How long each offered time is. A booking link uses its own length.

commands.name: scheduled-windows
commands.title: Scheduled Windows
commands.subtitle: Leaf Calendar
commands.description: Book or delete the time windows you offered.

preferences.name: daysAhead
preferences.title: Agenda Length
preferences.description: How many days My Agenda shows, starting today.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
